nov_2026_context.note: Cleartrip 13-14 Nov 2026, 13 Leh 3-star hotels (hostel, Pangong property and a 37,500 outlier excluded): discounted median 2,695, struck-through 'original' median 4,000. Published 2024-26 peak tariffs median 4,300. So peak tariffs sit near the OTA rack rate; the Nov OTA price is the rack rate minus a 30-50% off-season discount. What a July guest actually pays after OTA discount is NOT observed (Cleartrip carries 2027 rates for only 5 of 34 Leh properties tested).

leh.notes: Of 34 Leh properties tested on Cleartrip for 1 Jul 2027 only 5 returned rates (the rest 'No rooms available', i.e. 2027 inventory not loaded). Those 5 are mostly 4-star-labelled hotels at OTA contracted rates; same-property July/Nov ratios run 0.75 to 1.33 (median 1.0), and Dragon shows an identical price on 15 Jun, 1 Jul and 15 Aug, so these look like flat loaded rates, not peak demand pricing. Better peak evidence is the hotels' own season tariffs (EP double, ex-GST, Apr-Oct): median 4,300 over 5 hotels (2024-26). Kayak/Booking/Trivago/Hotels.com did not return usable 2027 prices (JS-rendered, blocked or no dates). Tripadvisor and Trivago returned HTTP 403 and were not bypassed.

kaza.notes: 5 usable of 18 Kaza properties tested returned 1 Jul 2027 rates (11 said 'No rooms available'; Juniper Home Kaza showed a 22,737 breakfast+dinner package, excluded as an outlier). Same-property July vs Nov: 1.0, 1.0, 1.21 and 0.91, i.e. no consistent peak premium on Cleartrip's loaded 2027 rates. The Nov Cleartrip median of the 4 then-priced hotels was 4,230 (Mahamaya 3,516, SOL ECO 3,849, Norbu 4,611, Yellow 5,839); the July set median 2,700 is lower because different, cheaper properties are open/loaded in July, not because prices fell. On the 4 same-property pairs: Jul median 2,610 vs Nov median 2,390. Dheeraj (DwD, updated 2 Oct 2026): Kaza mid-range hotels 1,500-3,000, budget homestays 500-1,000 (basic rooms, meals 100-200 extra), 'most guesthouses shut down from November to May', higher prices 'especially in July-August'. A search-result summary of Tripadvisor.in (page itself returned 403, not fetched) gives Kaza average nightly price Mar-May 2,876, Jun-Aug 3,355, Sep-Nov 4,505, i.e. Jun-Aug not above autumn. HPTDC Hotel Spiti tariff page would not resolve (DNS) and no tariff was seen.

gulmarg.notes: Gulmarg 14 Jan 2027 is 97 days out and loads; 17 Jun 2027 mostly does not. Jan vs Nov same-property pairs: 8 of 10 are identical to the rupee (the OTA is selling one flat contracted rate), while Sarwa Cottage Gulmarg is 1.69x on all four of its room types and Pine View Tangmarg 1.50x (Premium Deluxe) and 1.25x (Family Suite). Median ratio 1.0, mean about 1.1. This is almost certainly an under-read of real Gulmarg winter pricing: published and search-result evidence says Jan-Mar is the top season (a Trivago page, fetched by search only, quotes typical Jan 2027 6,625 per night, range 3,158-12,998, Feb 8,110, Mar 10,978 across all Gulmarg hotels; the page itself returned 403 and was not fetched). Hotel Highlands Park (luxury) publishes one tariff, 26,000 double with breakfast + GST effective 1 Apr 2025, no seasons. JKTDC huts show 3,500-3,850 per room, central heating +7,500 (skiingingulmarg.in, 20 Aug 2026), tariff periods not stated. Treat the Jan figure as a floor.

method_note: Dated prices: Cleartrip hotel detail pages with ?c=DDMMYYYY|DDMMYYYY (server-rendered, honours the date; listing pages ignore it). Kayak, Booking.com, Trip.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Hotels.com returned empty/JS-only/timeouts for 2027 dates; Tripadvisor and Trivago returned 403 (not bypassed). Cleartrip 2027 inventory for Ladakh/Spiti is thin: most properties say 'No rooms available' (not loaded, or closed). Where Cleartrip shows a price for both dates it is often identical (flat contracted rate), so a same-property ratio of 1.0 means 'OTA rate card unchanged', not 'no peak premium'. Prices pre-tax as listed unless stated; Cleartrip lists taxes & fees separately. No price came from memory.
key_finding: No place yields a clean dated peak-season median. Best-supported peak evidence: Leh hotels' own Apr-Oct season tariffs (EP double ex-GST median 4,300, n=5, 2024-26) vs Nov OTA discounted 3-star median 2,695 and Nov OTA struck rack median 4,000. Cleartrip same-property July-vs-Nov: Leh 0.75-1.33 (median 1.0, n=5), Kaza 0.91-1.21 (median 1.0, n=4), Gulmarg Jan 1.0-1.69 (median 1.0, n=10), Gulmarg June 1.0 and 1.54 (n=2).
